title: Remove tests that check the text or shape of the source code instead of behaviour
outcome: Remove tests that check the text or shape of the source code instead of behaviour
acceptance: Every Engram test that passes or fails on the text or shape of source code (line or byte counts, file, function or module counts, required phrases, module layout or grep-style scans of src) rather than observable behaviour is removed, with the list of removed tests and the reason for each recorded on this item
Tests that read files only as fixtures or to locate the crate, and the source_id input identity, are kept
No replacement static gate is added
AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md state the ban in the portable wording agreed by Kimi::Consultant and both coordinators
disposal_reason: Duplicate. Kimi::Consultant filed w-4db2ad8f695f (c15db92c #385) for the same inventory and removal of source-text/shape tests, covering both Engram and TermAl. My grep candidates are in this item's note for Kimi to reuse.
